plan_standard.title: Standard
plan_standard.description: For the financial basics — everything you need for better money management in one place. Sending money abroad or sticking to a budget has never been easier.

plan_plus.title: Plus
plan_plus.description: For the smart spender — access additional benefits like better limits for spending abroad and insurance for your purchases, on our affordable paid plan.

plan_premium.title: Premium
plan_premium.description: For elevating every day — access exclusive subscriptions, better savings rates, and exchange unlimited amounts of money.

plan_metal.title: Metal
plan_metal.description: For the global travellers and traders — relax with travel insurance, enjoy enhanced limits, and subscriptions worth £2,200 annually.

plan_ultra.title: Ultra
plan_ultra.description: For those seeking the best of Revolut — get exceptional benefits like unlimited airport lounge access, monthly global data, partner subscriptions, and cancellation cover.
